text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Good grief. It really lacks any real punch, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's not like I'm feeling out of shape or anything!
I've still got plenty of energy in me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not the type to get tired over something like this!
There are just times when I feel a wiiit weird, is all."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back to my unstoppable self in no time!
Full throttle, and the crowd'll go totally wild!

Maruzensky insists she's fine,
but she might need some rest.
Perhaps I should reconsider her race schedule...
